I currently have equal amounts of A, B, and C. Trading 1 B for 1 A would reduce variety and make my bundle less balanced, so it does not improve my utility.

Starting from 1A, 1B, 1C, trading 1B for 2A gives 3A, 0B, 1C. Since all goods are equally valuable and I prefer variety, this reduces variety by eliminating B, but gaining two units for one makes the bundle more valuable overall.
